MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub jobs|queue [options]

Live job queue dashboard (server load, ETA)

Options:
  --interval <sec>  Polling interval in seconds (default: "5")
  --once            Print one snapshot and exit (no Ink TUI)
  --json            Print raw JSON and exit
  --window <days>   Window for history stats in days (default: "7")
  -h, --help        display help for command
